The first release: a second look at your coding assistant's replies, in Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code and Factory Droid.

## ✨ Added

- **A check at the end of every turn.** A small model reads the final reply and sends it back once when it names a gap without a way to close it, asks for approval without showing what to approve, or walks past a clearly better method, tool, skill or helper. Everything else goes through untouched.
- **A note on every prompt.** It asks the assistant to look for a better method, a fitting tool, an installed skill, plugin or MCP server, or a helper the project already has before it takes the obvious route. The note costs no model call and can be switched off or reworded.
- **Five tools from one repository.** Claude Code and Qwen Code run the check as a prompt hook. Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and Factory Droid start a second, headless run of the same CLI on a small model, and a check that fails or runs too long lets the reply through.
- **Tests without a model.** `node test/run.mjs offline` checks the hook script for every tool, and the full run drives each installed CLI through sample replies.
